content.text:
I've grouped Nanjing's main IGCSE/A Level schools by how much evidence there is for their exam results. One caveat first: almost all the published results come from the schools themselves or from local media and agencies. None of them are independently audited, so treat these figures as marketing and verify them directly.

## Tier 1: Strongest, most transparent exam results

**1. The British School of Nanjing (BSN, part of Nord Anglia)**
- This is the only Nanjing school that publishes its actual A Level grade data every year. It calls itself the city's longest-running British international school. ([Nord Anglia](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bsn-nanjing))
- **2026:** 58% of A Level grades were A*–A, up 9.4% on 2025. ([Nord Anglia, Aug 2026](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/news/2026/08/14/nord-anglia-education-students-achieve-exceptional-2026-a-level-results))
- **2025:** 54% A*/A, 74% A*–B and a 100% pass rate. Art was a standout, with 70% of students getting an A*. ([BSN 2025 results](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bsn-nanjing/news/2025/august/a-levels-results/a-level-results))
- **Inconsistency to check:** another BSN page says "74% achieved an A*" in 2025. That conflicts with the 54% A*–A figure and is probably a mislabelled A*–B number. Ask the school.
- **IGCSE:** the school says two students got the world's top IGCSE scores in languages, including Mandarin.
- **Practical details:** day school for ages 2–18, fees about RMB 122,000–287,000 a year, typical class size 18. ([doris.school](https://www.doris.school/schools/china/the-british-school-of-nanjing))
- As a school for children of foreign nationals, it usually requires a foreign passport. Confirm whether your child is eligible.

## Tier 2: Top public-school international programmes (mainly for Chinese nationals)

**2. Nanjing Foreign Language School (NFLS, 南京外国语学校), Cambridge class**
- Cambridge approved it as an exam centre in 2006, when it started its A Level programme. It also runs IB and a Canadian (BC) programme. ([xhd.cn](https://nj.xhd.cn/highschool/955236.html), [doris.school](https://www.doris.school/schools/china/nanjing-foreign-language-school))
- Chinese media name NFLS as one of the stronger Jiangsu schools for Cambridge University admissions. ([QQ News](https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250205A06FYB00))
- Its Xianlin campus A Level programme claims 100% admission to global top-50 universities for the 2026 cohort. ([QQ News](https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260408A04PNN00))

**3. Nanjing Jinling High School (金陵中学), Cambridge class**
- Its Cambridge A Level centre opened in 2008. ([Dipont](https://www.dipont-edu.org/schools-nanjing-jinling.php))
- The 52 graduates of 2025 received 367 offers in total. These included 1 from Cambridge, 4 from Imperial and 37 from UCL. The school reports a 75% admission rate to the UK's "G5" (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial, UCL, LSE). ([QQ News](https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250709A02CMG00))
- Admission is based only on zhongkao (high-school entrance exam) scores, with no extra entrance test. ([QQ News](https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250511A06RRK00))

## Tier 3: Newer private bilingual schools (less published data)

**4. RGS Guildford Nanjing (南京金地未来学校)**
- Opened in 2020 as a partnership with the Royal Grammar School Guildford in the UK. Boarding is available. ([doris.school](https://www.doris.school/schools/china/rgs-guildford-nanjing))
- A third-party directory reports 50% A*/A at A Level and 44% A*/A at IGCSE in 2023. ([AISD](https://alifaedtech.com/schools/rgs-guildford-nanjing))

**5. Nanjing Thomas School (南京安生学校)**
- Offers Cambridge IGCSE and A Level.
- Claims that over 40% of its 2023 graduates got offers from QS world top-30 universities, such as Imperial, UCL and Edinburgh. ([AISD](https://alifaedtech.com/schools/nanjing-thomas-school))

**6. NFLS Yuhua International Academy**
- Founded in 2019. It is a Cambridge exam centre (CN664) offering IGCSE and A Level. ([AISD](https://alifaedtech.com/schools/nanjing-foreign-language-school-yuhua-international-academy))

**Others:** EtonHouse Nanjing and Bona Sonority School also offer Cambridge A Levels, but I found no published results for them.

## If you're open to IB
**Nanjing International School (NIS)** doesn't offer A Levels, but it is arguably the city's strongest school by results. In 2025 its IB average was 35 points (world average 30), with a 100% pass rate and two perfect scores of 45. ([NIS](https://www.nischina.org/community-belonging/school-news/newsposts/~board/featured-news/post/outstanding-2025-ib-results))

## Which to consider
- **Foreign passport holders wanting a British curriculum:** BSN is the clear first choice.
- **Chinese nationals with strong zhongkao scores:** NFLS or Jinling.
- **Bilingual or boarding needs:** RGS Guildford Nanjing.

**Questions to ask each school:**
- Full grade breakdowns for the last 3 years, not just highlights
- How many students actually sat the exams
- Whether every student sits the exams, or only selected ones
- Where graduates actually enrolled, not just offers received
